candidates.name: JLL
candidates.description: JLL is a direct global competitor providing commercial real estate brokerage, property management, and investment advisory services.
candidates.rationale: JLL directly overlaps CBRE in commercial real estate brokerage, property management, valuation, and investment advisory for the same enterprise property clients.

candidates.name: Cushman & Wakefield
candidates.description: Cushman & Wakefield operates as a top-tier global commercial real estate services leader with a nearly identical suite of service offerings.
candidates.rationale: Both are global commercial real estate services firms offering leasing, facilities management, valuation, and investment or asset-management services to similar clients.

candidates.name: Colliers
candidates.description: Colliers is a major global player providing diversified professional services and investment management in the commercial real estate sector.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate advisory, leasing, property management, valuation, and investment services to overlapping corporate and investor buyers.

candidates.name: Newmark Group
candidates.description: Newmark provides comprehensive commercial real estate advisory and brokerage services to institutional clients globally.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate brokerage and advisory services to institutional property owners, investors, and occupiers.

candidates.name: Savills plc
candidates.description: Savills operates as a leading international property advisor providing a full spectrum of real estate brokerage and management services.
candidates.rationale: Savills directly overlaps CBRE in commercial real estate brokerage, property management, valuation, and advisory services for similar corporate and investor buyers.

candidates.name: Knight Frank Group
candidates.description: Knight Frank provides global real estate consultancy, brokerage, and valuation services to both commercial and residential clients.
candidates.rationale: Knight Frank overlaps CBRE in commercial real estate brokerage, consultancy, valuation, and property services for the same corporate and investor buyers.

candidates.name: NAI Global
candidates.description: NAI Global operates a worldwide network of commercial real estate brokerage firms specializing in leasing, buying, and selling property.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate brokerage and leasing services to businesses and property investors with closely overlapping buyer needs.

candidates.name: Lee & Associates, Llc
candidates.description: Lee & Associates provides a full array of commercial real estate brokerage services, including industrial, office, and retail property solutions.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate brokerage and property services to businesses seeking industrial, office, or retail leasing and transaction support.

candidates.name: Transwestern Hospitality Group
candidates.description: Transwestern is a diversified real estate company that offers integrated property management, development, and investment services.
candidates.rationale: Both provide integrated commercial real estate services, including property management and investment services, to property owners and investors.

candidates.name: Marcus & Millichap
candidates.description: Marcus & Millichap specializes in commercial real estate investment sales and brokerage services across North America.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate brokerage and investment services to property owners and investors, with clear overlap in investment sales and advisory needs.

candidates.name: Stream Realty Group
candidates.description: Stream Realty Partners delivers a broad scope of commercial real estate services including leasing, property management, and facility oversight.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate leasing, property management, and facilities services to property owners and occupiers.

candidates.name: Lincoln Property Company
candidates.description: Lincoln Property Company provides nationwide services in commercial real estate development, property management, and leasing.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate services, including property management and leasing, to overlapping property owners, investors, and occupiers.

candidates.name: Hines
candidates.description: Hines is a global leader in real estate investment, development, and property management for commercial and residential assets.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate investment and property/asset management services to institutional owners and investors.

candidates.name: Bridge Investment Group, LLC
candidates.description: Bridge Investment Group acts as an alternative asset manager with a heavy focus on managing diverse commercial real estate property types.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate investment and asset management services to institutional investors and property stakeholders.

candidates.name: Trammell Crow Company
candidates.description: Trammell Crow Company provides comprehensive development and investment services for commercial real estate occupiers and investors.
candidates.rationale: Trammell Crow is a CBRE subsidiary, making it an affiliated business rather than an independent lookalike prospect.

candidates.name: Northmarq Capital, LLC
candidates.description: Northmarq operates as a full-service capital markets resource specializing in financing and investment sales for commercial real estate.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate investment and capital-market services to property owners and investors, with overlapping transaction and advisory needs.

candidates.name: OR
candidates.description: OR provides integrated development and property solutions, aligning with the real estate development segment of full-service firms.
candidates.rationale: OR is primarily a real estate developer, not a commercial property services firm offering leasing, valuation, facilities, and asset management.

candidates.name: Raine & Horne SA
candidates.description: Raine & Horne provides real estate brokerage and agency services, primarily in the Australian property market.
candidates.rationale: Raine & Horne is primarily a residential property agency, while CBRE targets commercial property owners, investors, and corporate occupiers with broader services.

candidates.name: Mrveco
candidates.description: MRV&CO is a large-scale real estate development firm focusing on residential and commercial property solutions.
candidates.rationale: MRV&CO primarily develops properties, while CBRE provides commercial real estate advisory, leasing, facilities, valuation, and asset-management services.

candidates.name: Crec
candidates.description: CREC engages in large-scale real estate development and infrastructure management, overlapping with development service lines.
candidates.rationale: CREC is primarily an infrastructure construction and development company, not a commercial real estate advisory, leasing, facilities, valuation, and asset-management provider.
